title: Depth under tree conversion
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let $T$ be a coordinate decision tree with values in $\alpha$. For any set of available coordinates for which $T$ is well formed—that is, every queried coordinate is available and both child trees are well formed after that coordinate is removed—the depth of the converted tree, which only queries available coordinates, equals the depth of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is well formed for that set
